content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-8. - Initiating procedure.
content.summary:
The procedure for acquiring or improving, or acquiring and improving, any project
               can be initiated in one of the following ways:
(1)
Provisional order method; or
(2)
Petition method.
(Code 1981, § 27-9; Ord. No. 551, § 7, 5-14-1964)
